args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 Summary
args.body:
- Newsletter topic: Cold-chain logistics in 2026, highlighting the shift toward live sensor data sharing between carriers.
- Main article: Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data; most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- Companion piece: Pilots of this data-sharing approach cut claims by roughly a quarter, reinforcing the main article's findings on reduced losses.
